Two arms extracted from this 12-month UK RCT (D'Aiuto et al., Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol 2018; ISRCTN83229304):

- **IPT arm (n=133):** Whole-mouth subgingival scaling under local analgesia (no time limit), followed at 2 months by either periodontal surgery (good oral hygiene + residual ≥6 mm pockets) or repeat subgingival scaling, then 3-monthly supportive subgingival scaling to 12 months → classified `SI_alone` (no antimicrobial adjunct).
- **CPT arm (n=131):** Supragingival scaling and polishing at matching timepoints (baseline, 2, 6, 9, 12 months) → classified `supragingival_only`.
